name: Sam's Club Member's Mark Turkey & Swiss Croissant Sandwich Platter
brandOrRestaurant: Sam's Club Deli & Bakery (Logan / South Jordan, UT)
whyItWorks: Flaky all-butter bakery croissants layered with sliced oven-roasted turkey breast and aged Swiss cheese are soft, low-residue, and easy to pack for family gatherings or road trips.
prepOrOrderInstructions: Remove any raw leaf lettuce leaf before eating and enjoy the turkey, Swiss cheese, and soft croissant plain or with a light touch of mayo.
